text: Aurelia is the autumn bridal collection from the Madison Avenue salon, built around silk crepe and Chantilly lace. Collection overview and background: it launched in September with 24 styles across five silhouettes.
Collection overview for Aurelia, first quarter: a cheap tulle entry line widened the price range, and the background of the lace supply moved to a single Lyon mill.
The Madison Avenue salon schedules private fittings on weekday mornings and keeps a walk-in rack of sample sizes six to sixteen.
Brisbane Flagship Showroom overview: the evening gown range occupies the entire first floor and is refreshed every six weeks. Showroom traffic peaks in the fortnight before the racing carnival.
Evening gown showroom overview for Brisbane: bias-cut satin gowns lead sales while heavily beaded styles drive the highest margins and the longest alteration times.
